I have worked this land in Mulanje for many years, and I know what my family can afford. On this small sorghum plot, I will spread manure from my animals and a little fertilizer if I have some left from the maize plot, because the soil is tired. My children and I will do all the work ourselves—we cannot pay for laborers or expensive chemicals. We depend on the rains, so I will not irrigate, and I will use the same sorghum seed I saved from last year.
